uncertainty_notes: Tiny module: lazy singleton factory for the anon Supabase client. Correctly throws on missing env vars at first call (not module-load) per BL-01 contract. `persistSession: false` is correct for server-side use. The cache is module-level — process-lifetime singleton. No correctness or security concerns. Operator constraint reminder: URL-obscurity trust model (D-D2) is satisfied since anon role only has SELECT on the relevant tables.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No direct test that the lazy factory THROWS when env vars are missing (the contract documented in lines 36-38).

test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Unset env vars; call getSupabase(); assert throws with the exact message; reset cache between test runs.
